_source.status: Repealed for offences committed on or after 1 July 2024 by Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023
_source.note: Legacy IPC sections included for reference in documents and judgments predating 1 July 2024. Mappings to BNS included only where verified from official comparative tables published by UP Police and Ministry of Home Affairs.
references: India Code (Ministry of Law and Justice): https://www.indiacode.nic.in/

sections.title: Unlawful assembly
sections.description: An assembly of five or more persons is designated as an unlawful assembly.

sections.title: Punishment for unlawful assembly
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine up to ₹1,000, or both
sections.description: Whoever is a member of an unlawful assembly.

sections.title: Joining unlawful assembly armed with deadly weapon
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever, being armed with any deadly weapon or with anything which, used as a weapon of offence, is likely to cause death, is a member of an unlawful assembly.

sections.title: Rioting
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever is a member of an unlawful assembly and uses force or violence.

sections.title: Rioting armed with deadly weapon
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever is a member of an unlawful assembly and is armed with any deadly weapon.

sections.title: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object
sections.punishment: Same as for the offence committed
sections.description: If an offence is committed by any member of an unlawful assembly in prosecution of the common object.

sections.title: Murder
sections.punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, and fine
sections.description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

sections.title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder.

sections.title: Causing death by negligence
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever causes the death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act.

sections.title: Abetment of suicide
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: If any person commits suicide, whoever abets the commission of such suicide.

sections.title: Attempt to murder
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge, and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of murder.

sections.title: Attempt to commit culpable homicide
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge and under such circumstances that, if he by that act caused death, he would be guilty of culpable homicide.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing hurt
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year plus fine up to ₹1,000
sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 334, voluntarily causes hurt.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 334, voluntarily causes hurt by means of any instrument for shooting.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 335, voluntarily causes grievous hurt.

sections.title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
sections.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever, except in the case provided for by section 335, voluntarily causes grievous hurt by means of any instrument for shooting.

sections.title: Sexual harassment
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: A man commits sexual harassment if he: (i) physical contact and advances involving unwelcome and explicit sexual overtures; (ii) demands or requests for sexual favours; (iii) showing pornography against the will of a woman; (iv) making sexually coloured remarks.

sections.title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe
sections.punishment: Imprisonment for 3 to 7 years
sections.description: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman, intending to outrage or knowing it to be likely that he will thereby outrage her modesty.

sections.title: Voyeurism
sections.punishment: Imprisonment for 1 to 3 years for first offence
sections.description: Whoever watches, or captures the image of a woman engaging in a private act.

sections.title: Stalking
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years for first offence
sections.description: Whoever follows a woman and contacts, or attempts to contact such woman repeatedly.

sections.title: Punishment for rape
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 7 years to life, and fine
sections.description: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than seven years.

sections.title: Punishment for causing death or resulting in persistent vegetative state of victim
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 20 years up to life, or death
sections.description: Whoever commits rape and causes death or results in persistent vegetative state of the victim.

sections.title: Gang rape
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 20 years up to life, and fine
sections.description: Where a woman is raped by one or more persons constituting a group.

sections.title: Theft
sections.description: Whoever intends to take dishonestly any moveable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent.

sections.title: Punishment for theft
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.

sections.title: Theft in dwelling house
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever commits theft in any building, tent or vessel.

sections.title: Punishment for robbery
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment.

sections.title: Punishment for dacoity
sections.punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for minimum 10 years up to life, and fine
sections.description: Whoever commits dacoity shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than ten years.

sections.title: Dishonest misappropriation of property
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use any property.

sections.title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years, or with fine, or with both
sections.description: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished.

sections.title: Criminal breach of trust by public servant
sections.punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment up to 10 years, and fine
sections.description: Whoever, being in any manner entrusted with property as a public servant, commits criminal breach of trust.

sections.title: Cheating
sections.description: Whoever, by deceiving any person, fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person so deceived to deliver any property.

sections.title: Punishment for cheating
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property.

sections.title: Forgery
sections.description: Whoever makes any false document or part of a document with intent to cause damage.

sections.title: Forgery for purpose of cheating
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever commits forgery, intending that the document forged shall be used for the purpose of cheating.

sections.title: Using as genuine a forged document
sections.punishment: Same as for forgery
sections.description: Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly uses or attempts to use as genuine any forged document.

sections.title: Cruelty by husband or relatives of husband
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years plus fine
sections.description: Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty shall be punished.

sections.title: Criminal intimidation
sections.description: Whoever threatens another with any injury to his person, reputation or property.

sections.title: Punishment for criminal intimidation
sections.punishment: Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both
sections.description: Whoever commits the offence of criminal intimidation.
